measure.official_title: City of Castle Pines Ballot Question 300

entries.neutral_title: Charter amendment requiring voter approval to annex property over 20 acres
entries.detail: Citizen-initiated amendment to the Castle Pines Home Rule Charter. Annexation of property over 20 acres held by one owner or group, or part of a common plan of development, would require approval by city voters; serial annexations of multiple parcels would be aggregated.

evidence.section: Douglas County 2026 General Election composite sample ballot (accessible version), City of Castle Pines, Ballot Question 300
evidence.quote: Should the City of Castle Pines Home Rule Charter be amended to include the following provision: Property in excess of 20 acres owned or controlled by a single owner or ownership group or that are part of a common plan of development or related transactions may be annexed into the City only upon approval by the voters at an election of the registered electors of the City of Castle Pines, Colorado, and for purposes of this provision, any single, successive, cumulative, serial or simultaneous annexations of multiple parcels shall be aggregated and treated as a single annexation as provided in C.R.S. Section 31-12-104(1)(a)?

evidence.section: City of Castle Pines Notice of Election (2026-08-21), question heading

verification.against: Douglas County Clerk and Recorder, 2026 General Election composite sample ballot (accessible version), and City of Castle Pines Notice of Election

limitations: Resolutions 26-50 and 26-51 set the ballot titles for the two citizen-initiated charter amendments but are scanned PDFs without a text layer; which resolution corresponds to which question was not established, so sources.resolution is null. URLs: https://www.castlepinesco.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Resolution-26-50-Setting-a-Ballot-Title-for-a-Citizen-Initiated-Amendment-to-the-Home-Rule-Charter-for-the-Coordinated-Election-on-Nov.-3.pdf ; https://www.castlepinesco.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Resolution-26-51-Setting-a-Ballot-Title-for-a-Citizen-Initiated-Amendment-to-the-Home-Rule-Charter-for-the-Coordinated-Election-on-Nov.-3.pdf
The city Notice of Election prints the statute citation as "31-12-104(1)(A)"; the county ballot prints "(1)(a)". The quote follows the county ballot.
Classified under land use as a growth control (voter approval of annexations); the question creates no tax, fee or housing earmark. Flagged for owner review.

measure.official_title: City of Castle Pines Ballot Question 301

entries.neutral_title: Charter amendment referring annexations over 20 acres made within 180 days to a voter ratification election
entries.detail: Citizen-initiated amendment to the Castle Pines Home Rule Charter. A parcel over 20 acres annexed within 180 days of the provision taking effect would be referred to city voters for ratification; if no such annexation occurs in that period, Council may repeal the provision by ordinance.

evidence.section: Douglas County 2026 General Election composite sample ballot (accessible version), City of Castle Pines, Ballot Question 301
evidence.quote: Should the City of Castle Pines Home Rule Charter be amended to include the following provision: Any parcel over 20 acres owned or controlled by a single owner or ownership group annexed within 180 days of the effective date of this section shall be referred for ratification at an election of the registered electors of the City of Castle Pines, Colorado, and if no such annexation occurs within such 180-day period, this section may be repealed by Council ordinance without a vote of the registered electors of the City of Castle Pines, Colorado?
